Q1001.reason: A proper end-of-period notice was given, but serving it immediately after the tenant won on habitability is classic retaliatory eviction, which bars possession.

Q1008.reason: Outrageous conduct with the barber present and known heart disease supports third-party IIED when bodily harm results; family status and unforeseeability do not defeat the claim.

Q938.reason: Effective chest compressions require the patient supine on a firm surface so the sternum can be compressed against a solid base.
